new = '''    def optimise_direct(self, low):
        """Emergency replan on the literal certificate arcs.

        Identical objective, but every eligible (slot, window) pair is an
        explicit residual arc; used when the compressed plan fails to verify.
        """
        S, J, F, G, K = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G, self.K
        g = GL.Graph(K, costed=True)
        cimap = [0] * self.narcs
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            for k in (0, 1, 2, 3):
                a = blk[k]
                if a < 0:
                    continue
                cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.capa[a], 0)
        dense_arcs = []
        for i in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):
            dense_arcs.append(g.add(self.tail[i], self.head[i], 1, self.cost[i]))
        for j in range(J):
            a = self.win_arc[j]
            cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], 1, 0)
        P = self.big_m(low)
        urew = []
        urest = []
        for f in range(F):
            z = self.zbase + f
            h = self.fhead[f]
            urew.append(g.add(z, h, low[f], -P))
            urest.append(g.add(z, h, self.ceiling[f] - low[f], 0))
        for gidx in range(G):
            a = self.group_arc[gidx]
            cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.gceil[gidx], 0)
        order = self.dag_order()
        pot = GL.pot_from_dag(K, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, order)
        GL.mincost_negative_augment(K, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, pot,
                                    self.R, self.Z, J)
        cap = g.cap
        asg = [-1] * J
        for t in range(len(dense_arcs)):
            if cap[dense_arcs[t]] == 0:
                asg[self.pairs[t][1]] = self.pairs[t][0]
        nsel = 0
        for j in range(J):
            if asg[j] >= 0:
                nsel += 1
        nf = []
        for f in range(F):
            a = urew[f]
            b = urest[f]
            nf.append((low[f] - cap[a]) + (self.ceiling[f] - low[f] - cap[b]))
        self.opt_pot = pot[:K]
        self.cimap = cimap
        self.urew = urew
        self.urest = urest
        self.assignment = asg
        self.nsel = nsel
        self.nf = nf
        flow = [0] * self.narcs
        for i in range(self.narcs):
            if self.dense_start <= i < self.dense_end:
                continue
            flow[i] = self.capa[i] - cap[cimap[i]]
        for f in range(F):
            flow[self.flow_arc[f]] = nf[f]
        for t in range(len(dense_arcs)):
            if cap[dense_arcs[t]] == 0:
                flow[self.dense_start + t] = 1
        flow[self.back_arc] = nsel
        self.arcflow = flow
        U = 0
        A = 0
        for j in range(J):
            s = asg[j]
            if s >= 0:
                U += self.value[j]
                A += self.times[s] - self.ready[j]
        self.utility = U
        self.age = A
